title: Homogeneity of Gaussian noise
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $\rho,c\in\mathbb R$, and $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$. The Gaussian noise operator at parameter $\rho$ sends $cf$ to $c$ times its value on $f$, pointwise.
